# therapist.com

> A comprehensive mental health platform connecting users with licensed therapists and providing evidence-based educational resources on mental health conditions, therapy types, and treatment options.

therapist.com serves as both a therapist directory for finding licensed mental health professionals and an educational resource hub offering guides on mental health disorders, therapy approaches, and self-care strategies. The platform features content from mental health experts and covers a wide range of topics from depression and trauma to relationship dynamics and sleep health.

## Key Topics

- Mental health disorders
- Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT)
- CBT-I (Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia)
- Online therapy
- Therapist directory
- Depression
- Anxiety
- Trauma and PTSD
- Relationship therapy
- Sexual health
- Personality disorders
- Sleep and mental health
- Treatment guides
- Emotionally focused therapy (EFT)
- Mental health resources

## Find a Therapist

- [Search our therapist directory by state](https://therapist.com/find-a-therapist): Therapist directory search by state for mental health professionals
- [Find a licensed therapist for online or in-person consultations](https://therapist.com): Homepage for therapist directory with therapy types and mental health resources
- [How to find free or affordable therapy](https://therapist.com/resources/free-affordable-therapy): Guide to free and low-cost therapy options including community clinics

## Mental Health Disorders & Conditions

- [Depression: Causes, types, diagnosis, and treatment](https://therapist.com/disorders/depression): Comprehensive guide to depression symptoms, causes, and treatment options
- [Religious trauma: Definition, signs, causes, and treatment](https://therapist.com/trauma/religious-trauma): Educational guide on religious trauma, spiritual abuse, and healing
- [Psychopathy: Signs, causes, and treatment](https://therapist.com/disorders/psychopathy): Educational overview of psychopathy and antisocial personality disorder
- [Machiavellianism: What it is, signs, and how to deal with it](https://therapist.com/personality/machiavellianism): Educational overview of Machiavellianism personality trait
- [Rumination: Meaning, signs, impact, and how to manage it](https://therapist.com/brain-and-body/rumination): Educational guide on rumination, thinking patterns, and management

## Therapy Types & Treatment Approaches

- [Emotionally focused therapy (EFT)](https://therapist.com/types-of-therapy/emotionally-focused-therapy-eft): Guide to EFT therapy approach for relationship and emotional issues
- [Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I)](https://therapist.com/types-of-therapy/cognitive-behavioral-therapy-for-insomnia): Comprehensive guide to CBT-I therapy for insomnia treatment
- [Therapy for sleep problems: What works best?](https://therapist.com/types-of-therapy/therapy-for-sleep-problems): Guide to sleep therapy including CBT-I and other treatment methods

## Sexual Health & Intimacy

- [Are sex addiction and porn addiction real disorders?](https://therapist.com/sex-intimacy/sex-addiction-porn-addiction): Overview of sex and porn addiction, warning signs, and treatment
- [Porn addiction symptoms and treatment options](https://therapist.com/sex-intimacy/porn-addiction-symptoms-treatment): Guide to porn addiction symptoms and evidence-based treatment options

## Self-Care & Wellness

- [Sleep and mental health](https://therapist.com/self-care/sleep): Educational content on sleep-mental health connection and self-care
- [What is the three-month rule for dating?](https://therapist.com/relationships/three-month-rule): Article on dating timeline and relationship commitment psychology
